prompt:
Write the appraiser's remarks (about 80 words) on a body shop repair estimate after a parking lot collision. Describe the damage seen on the vehicle and the repair plan. No names, dates or amounts. (Internal reference C-1208; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- It is not clear whether all of the damage came from this impact.
- The bills show no repeated charges.
- The repair labor hours fit the damage.
- No earlier damage to the vehicle is known.
text: The rear bumper cover is cracked across the center and the left taillight assembly is broken, with scuffing on the lower quarter panel that is consistent with a low-speed strike in a parking lot. Some of the damage to the left rear door seam may have come from this impact, but it is not clear whether all of it did, so the repair plan notes that area for a closer look once the bumper is off. The repair labor hours fit the damage described, and the parts list lines up with the visible harm. No earlier damage to the vehicle is known from the file or the owner's account. The invoices submitted show no repeated charges, and the plan is to replace the bumper cover and taillight, refinish the quarter panel, and reassess the door seam before final approval.
